quotations.old_english: Sam gé etan, sam gé drincan, sam gé áht elles gedón
quotations.latin: siue manducatis, siue bibitis, siue aliud quid facietis

quotations.old_english: Sam þe þeów, sam þe frig
Sam þe fram þám foresǽdon fæder, sam þe fram æfterfyligendum hys
quotations.latin: tam a predicto patre, quam a sequacibus suis

quotations.old_english: Sam þe him sylfum, sam æftergencgum hyra

source_text: sam. Add: (1) sam . . . sam :-- Sam (tam) gebróþrum, sam (quam) eallum geleáffullum, Angl. xiii. 414, 706. Sam gé etan, sam gé drincan, sam gé áht elles gedón siue manducatis, siue bibitis, siue aliud quid facietis, Scint. 169, 12. (2) sam þe . . . sam þe :-- Sam þe þeów, sam þe frig siue servus, siue liber, Scint. 189, 14: 226, 13. Sam þe fram þám foresǽdon fæder, sam þe fram æfterfyligendum hys tam a predicto patre, quam a sequacibus suis, Angl. xiii. 375, 140: 377, 176. (2 a) sam þe . . . sam :-- Sam þe him sylfum, sam æftergencgum hyra tam sibi, quam successoribus suis, Angl. xiii. 447, 1176.
